import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Handle missing values in 'Sleep Disorder' column
# Replace NaN with 'No Disorder' for better categorical plotting
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('No Disorder')

# Set a stylish seaborn theme for better aesthetics
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure with two subplots to compare Sleep Duration and Quality across disorders
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 6))

# Plot 1: Distribution of Sleep Duration by Sleep Disorder using violin plot
sns.violinplot(x='Sleep Disorder', y='Sleep Duration', data=df, ax=axes[0], palette='viridis', inner='quartile')
axes[0].set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14)
axes[0].set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15) # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability if they overlap

# Plot 2: Distribution of Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder using violin plot
sns.violinplot(x='Sleep Disorder', y='Quality of Sleep', data=df, ax=axes[1], palette='plasma', inner='quartile')
axes[1].set_title('Quality of Sleep Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14)
axes[1].set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10 Score)', fontsize=12)
axes[1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15) # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability

# Add an overall title for the entire figure
fig.suptitle('Impact of Sleep Disorders on Sleep Duration and Quality Metrics', fontsize=16, y=1.02)

# Adjust layout to prevent titles and labels from overlapping
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.98]) # Adjust rect to make space for suptitle

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Handle missing values in 'Sleep Disorder' column
# Replace NaN with 'No Disorder' for better categorical plotting
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('No Disorder')

# Set a stylish seaborn theme for better aesthetics
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure with two subplots to compare Sleep Duration and Quality across disorders
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 6))

# Plot 1: Distribution of Sleep Duration by Sleep Disorder using violin plot
sns.violinplot(x='Sleep Disorder', y='Sleep Duration', data=df, ax=axes[0], palette='viridis', inner='quartile')
axes[0].set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14)
axes[0].set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15) # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability if they overlap

# Plot 2: Distribution of Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder using violin plot
sns.violinplot(x='Sleep Disorder', y='Quality of Sleep', data=df, ax=axes[1], palette='plasma', inner='quartile')
axes[1].set_title('Quality of Sleep Distribution by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14)
axes[1].set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
axes[1].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10 Score)', fontsize=12)
axes[1].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=15) # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability

# Add an overall title for the entire figure
fig.suptitle('Impact of Sleep Disorders on Sleep Duration and Quality Metrics', fontsize=16, y=1.02)

# Adjust layout to prevent titles and labels from overlapping
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.98]) # Adjust rect to make space for suptitle

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
